description: Reviewed semantic classifications for individual records whose legacy Growth Zone identifies a Method or Lens rather than a concrete Topic, or whose reviewed effective content warrants a more precise Topic than the legacy collection. These overrides supplement compatibility navigation without changing stable URLs.

90-30-focus-rest-schedule.reason: The effective protocol alternates focused work with real breaks. Attention & Focus describes the work phase; Recovery & Energy describes the break/recovery phase. Antifragility remains a Lens.

triz-contradiction-coach.reason: The action uses contradiction templates to frame and solve problems. TRIZ remains the Method.

chef-taste-and-adjust.reason: The entry explicitly generalizes taste-judge-adjust-repeat into regular review and refinement of projects and tasks. Chef / Operations remains the Lens.

counterbalance-intense-activities-for-st.reason: The concrete action is to balance intense activity with lower-intensity or opposite activity to manage recovery and load. TRIZ remains the Method.

detective-mnemonic-memory-tricks.reason: The entry creates memory aids for observations. Detective remains the Lens.

hobby-diversification-tracker.reason: The concrete practice is to develop unfamiliar hobbies and skills outside the user's usual activity pattern. Antifragility remains a Lens rather than the Topic.

circles-of-control-planner.reason: The curated protocol separates controllable from uncontrollable factors to allocate action and reduce wasted effort under stress. Stoicism remains a Lens.

home-privacy-planner.reason: The action changes physical space to create privacy and solitude. This is broader than Workspace and belongs to Environment Design. Architecture remains a Lens.

spot-overlooked-details.reason: The action deliberately inspects small observations that may alter an interpretation or reveal an avoidable issue. Detective remains a Lens.

safety-statements-exposure-anxiety.reason: The reviewed protocol is graded facing of a manageable fear. Exposure remains the sensitive Method; Fear & Confidence is the user-facing Topic.

qa-feedback-loop-tracker.reason: The practice creates a recurring feedback-and-improvement loop for work. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-test-case-coverage-planner.reason: Test-case coverage is used to anticipate scenarios and prevent missed failures. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-workspace-organizer.reason: The practice organizes the work/testing environment to reduce friction and mistakes. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-severity-priority-coach.reason: The action ranks issues by severity and priority before acting. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-checklist-templates-runbook.reason: The practice uses reusable checklists/runbooks to prevent omissions in recurring work. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

read-the-room-trainer.reason: The entry observes tone, posture and other signals, treats interpretations as hypotheses, and uses low-risk follow-up questions. Fieldcraft remains a Lens.

repurpose-resources-save-time.reason: The action reframes existing resources for a new use to solve a constraint with less waste. TRIZ remains the Method.

reverse-thinking-triz.reason: The action deliberately reverses a normal assumption or approach to generate alternative solutions. TRIZ remains the Method.

ergonomic-workspace-assessment.reason: The entry changes a physical workspace for comfort and efficiency. Workspace captures the work context; Environment Design captures the physical-space dimension. Architecture remains a Lens.

pause-before-reacting-three-breaths-stoi.reason: The Stoic pause creates a short gap before reacting so the user can choose a response rather than act impulsively. Stoicism remains a Lens.

smart-home-roi-planner.reason: The entry evaluates and iterates technology that changes the physical environment, with explicit friction, privacy, cost and routine trade-offs. Architecture remains a Lens.

3-minute-sensory-mindfulness-act.reason: The reviewed practice uses sensory attention to return to the present and notice experience without claiming a universal treatment effect. ACT remains the sensitive Method.

stoic-acceptance-tracker.reason: The concrete practice is to acknowledge a difficult reality, reduce resistance, and choose a workable next action. Stoicism remains a Lens.

avoid-list-interference-memory-retention.reason: The reviewed effective content is now a sourced post-learning wakeful-rest experiment focused on declarative memory. Memory is the concrete Topic; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains only a compatibility URL and should not define the protocol semantically.

active-recall-test-yourself.reason: The reviewed protocol uses retrieval practice directly for memory retention and explicitly separates remembering from applying knowledge. Memory and Skill Learning are the concrete Topics; Retrieval Practice is the Method. The legacy Skill Sprint URL remains stable compatibility navigation.

ad-astra-per-aspera-motivation-tracker.reason: The curated protocol uses a short phrase only as a cue to choose and begin a controllable next action. Task Initiation is the concrete user-facing Topic; the legacy Phrases collection remains compatibility navigation.

analogy-studio.reason: The curated protocol explains an idea through a bounded analogy and tests the listener's paraphrase. It supports Clear Communication and Creative Problem Solving. The inherited NLP method label is suppressed because the effective protocol does not depend on NLP.

ask-better-interview-questions.reason: The curated protocol asks permission, follows a recent event in sequence and checks the summary with the speaker. Listening and Clear Communication are the concrete Topics; Detective remains a Lens.

ask-for-feedback-tracker.reason: The curated protocol uses another person's perspective to examine assumptions and improve an artifact or decision. Metacognition and Revision & Feedback are the concrete Topics; the legacy Thinking collection remains compatibility navigation.

avoid-anthropocentric-bias.reason: The effective protocol separates observable facts from interpretation and compares alternative explanations. Critical Thinking is the additional concrete Topic; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection already supplies the canonical bias Topic.

avoid-contrast-effect.reason: The effective protocol defines stable criteria, assesses options independently and then resolves trade-offs. Decision Making is the additional concrete Topic; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.

avoid-gamblers-fallacy-trust-the-odds.reason: The effective protocol distinguishes independent from connected events and applies a pre-defined rule under uncertainty. Decision Making and Data Literacy are the additional concrete Topics; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.

avoid-selection-bias-in-analysis.reason: The effective protocol inspects inclusion, exclusion and missing cases before generalizing. Critical Thinking and Data Literacy are the additional concrete Topics; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.

backfire-effect-coach.reason: The effective protocol clarifies a contested claim, states uncertainty and chooses a check or stopping point. Critical Thinking and Conflict Repair are the concrete Topics.

belief-update-coach.reason: The effective protocol makes the basis, uncertainty, revision and future change condition of a belief explicit. Critical Thinking and Metacognition are the concrete Topics.

biomimicry-creative-problem-solving.reason: The effective protocol translates a function into a transferable design principle and generates applications. Creative Problem Solving and Idea Generation are the concrete Topics.

bold-brainstorm-kickoff.reason: The effective protocol uses an extreme seed to produce variants, then restores constraints and selects one feasible test. Creative Problem Solving and Idea Generation are the concrete Topics.

ideal-sleep-hours-finder.reason: The reviewed effective content is about protecting adequate sleep opportunity and observing sleep timing and daytime function. Sleep & Circadian Rhythm is the concrete Topic; the legacy Be Healthy collection remains compatibility navigation.

relationship-repair-coach.reason: The reviewed effective content is a low-risk interpersonal repair attempt after a workable conflict: own the action, apologize for one's part, offer a concrete repair, and invite the other person's response. Conflict & Repair is primary; Relationships is also relevant.

refocus-present-stop-mind-wandering.reason: The reviewed drill practices voluntary attention selection and switching while asking the user to observe control of attention rather than symptom change. Attention & Focus and Metacognition are the concrete Topics; Metacognitive Therapy-derived records the source tradition without implying delivery of MCT.

dbt-distress-tolerance-coach.reason: The reviewed protocol notices an action urge, creates a harmless pause, and reassesses the next action. Emotion Regulation, Stress Regulation and Self-Awareness are the concrete Topics; DBT-derived identifies the sensitive source tradition and does not imply delivery of DBT treatment.

abdominal-breathing-stress-relief.reason: The reviewed protocol is a conservative body-focused relaxation exercise for everyday stress. Stress Regulation is the concrete Topic; Body-oriented remains a sensitive Method classification rather than an efficacy claim for body-oriented therapy.

cbt-action-mood-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol records situation, action and observed before/after state. Self-Awareness and Emotion Regulation are the concrete Topics; CBT-derived identifies the source tradition with an explicit non-therapy boundary.

cardio-health-daily-habits.reason: The reviewed protocol is general cardiovascular-health activity planning grounded in AHA guidance. Cardiovascular Health, Movement and Everyday Health Basics describe the bounded public use.

daily-gratitude-journal-three-things.reason: The reviewed protocol is an optional gratitude reflection with modest-evidence boundaries. Mood & Wellbeing and Self-Awareness describe the concrete use; Positive Psychotherapy-derived remains a sensitive Method label, not a claim that this page provides psychotherapy.

spaced-recall-coach.reason: The effective protocol concerns retention of verbal material through temporally distributed study and is directly mapped to Memory. The source does not justify a Skill Learning mapping, because skill acquisition and broader transfer were outside the reviewed synthesis. Cognitive Biases remains legacy navigation only.

ask-a-peer-to-proofread.reason: The curated protocol is specifically about revising writing by distinguishing surface-level from deep-level feedback and matching the feedback request to the intended revision outcome. Writing and Revision & Feedback are the concrete Topics; the legacy Avoid Errors Growth Zone remains only compatibility navigation.

30-min-eye-break-tracker.reason: The effective protocol interrupts long screen stretches and uses the pause as a work-quality checkpoint. Digital Attention and Error Prevention are the concrete Topics; Avoid Errors remains compatibility navigation.

478-breathing-technique-guide.reason: The effective content is a brief, comfortable pause intended to create space before the next action without treatment framing. Stress Regulation is the concrete Topic; Be Calm remains compatibility navigation.

create-win-win-outcomes.reason: The effective protocol maps interests, constraints and possible trades before choosing an agreement or no-deal. Strategy and Negotiation are the user-facing Topics; Game Theory remains a Method lens rather than proof of a win-win outcome.

achieve-multiple-goals-at-once.reason: The effective protocol checks whether one concrete action can serve two compatible priorities without hiding trade-offs. Planning & Prioritization and Goals are the concrete Topics; Grandmaster remains legacy navigation.

leave-an-app-review.reason: The effective protocol converts an observation into clear feedback by separating event, impact and optional suggestion. Revision & Feedback and Clear Communication are the concrete Topics; Grow Together remains compatibility navigation.

automatic-paycheck-to-savings.reason: The effective content is a reversible savings-automation hygiene protocol with explicit affordability boundaries. Personal Finance is the concrete Topic; Money remains compatibility navigation.

challenge-generalizations-counterexample.reason: The effective protocol tests absolute statements using genuine counterexamples. Critical Thinking and Cognitive Biases describe the practical task; NLP is retained only as a legacy review-required Method attached to the collection, not as scientific support.

ancestral-torch-resilience-tracker.reason: The effective protocol acknowledges difficulty and redirects attention to one controllable action. Stress Regulation and Psychological Flexibility are the concrete Topics; Phrases remains compatibility navigation.

decision-calibration-journal.reason: The effective protocol records expectations, confidence and assumptions before outcomes are known, then compares them later. Decision Making and Metacognition are the concrete Topics. The legacy Quantum collection remains only the stable compatibility URL, and its historical quantum-analogy lens is deliberately excluded from machine retrieval for this reviewed protocol.

ai-premortem-risk-planner.reason: The effective protocol uses AI to brainstorm candidate failure modes, then requires human verification before mitigation. Error Prevention, Decision Making and Work Systems are the concrete Topics; Thinking remains compatibility navigation.

brag-doc-wins-hub.reason: The effective protocol creates a compact work record designed for later retrieval and reuse, then folds that record into recurring review and planning. Information Management is primary; Work Systems covers the repeated capture-and-review workflow.

break-familiarity-bias.reason: The effective protocol examines whether a familiar default is being accepted without comparison and uses an explicit criterion to compare a viable alternative. Cognitive Biases captures the default-check lens; Decision Making captures the choice procedure.

bullet-point-coach.reason: The effective protocol prepares a compact speaking outline that preserves purpose, key information and the requested next step. Clear Communication directly describes the task without implying a separate evidence-backed presentation method.

calibrate-task-estimates.reason: The effective protocol records an estimate against a concrete deliverable, compares it with the eventual completion conditions and uses the difference to adjust future planning. Planning & Prioritization is primary; Work Systems captures the recurring calibration record.

challenge-assumed-intent.reason: The effective protocol identifies when intent has been inferred rather than observed, separates facts from interpretation, considers alternative explanations and checks missing information. Cognitive Biases captures the assumption check; Critical Thinking captures the verification procedure.

check-base-rates-before-deciding.reason: The effective protocol selects a relevant reference class, inspects the scope of a baseline and combines general frequency information with case-specific facts. Data Literacy is primary; Critical Thinking captures the applicability and uncertainty checks.

choose-best-resources.reason: The effective protocol filters information, tools and other inputs against a concrete next output and records a keep, test or archive decision. Information Management is primary; Work Systems covers the repeatable intake and evaluation workflow.

chunk-complex-ideas-for-clarity.reason: The effective protocol restructures complex material for a specific audience and decision while preserving supporting detail in retrievable layers. Clear Communication covers the presentation path; Information Management covers grouping, labeling and layered retrieval.

clarity-ladder-analyzer.reason: The effective protocol edits a message by connecting a general point with a concrete example and then reconnecting the detail to the message. Clear Communication is primary; Writing covers the same operation in written briefs, messages and explanations.

clustering-illusion-guard.reason: The effective protocol checks whether a visually compelling short sequence is being interpreted without its full denominator, observation window or context. Cognitive Biases captures the pattern-story risk; Data Literacy captures the denominator and context checks.

cognitive-dissonance-resolution.reason: The effective protocol makes a belief explicit, seeks strong counter-information, compares source relevance and independence and records an explicit update. Critical Thinking is primary; Cognitive Biases captures the tendency to protect an existing view from contradictory information.

common-source-radar.reason: The effective protocol verifies whether apparently separate claims trace back to independent or shared underlying material. Critical Thinking captures independence checking; Information Management captures source lineage and deduplication.

confidence-calibration-habit.reason: The effective protocol records confidence, support, unknowns and explicit update conditions, then compares the judgment with later outcomes. Metacognition captures monitoring one's own certainty; Decision Making captures how the update affects commitment.

confirmation-bias-challenge.reason: The effective protocol turns a favored assumption into a falsifiable pre-commitment check before an ordinary decision. Critical Thinking captures the disconfirming test; Decision Making captures the resulting update or escalation.

conjunction-fallacy-coach.reason: The effective protocol inspects the logical relationship between a condition and the same condition plus an additional requirement. Critical Thinking captures decomposition; Data Literacy captures correct interpretation of nested event sets.

context-guard-for-decisions.reason: The effective protocol adds situational constraints, stakeholders, verified facts and unknowns to an active choice before selecting a reversible next step. Decision Making directly captures the task; broader Problem Solving routing is intentionally omitted to avoid crowding hypothesis-specific retrieval.

context-planner-for-writers.reason: The effective protocol creates a pre-draft brief from reader, publication surface, purpose and constraints. Writing captures the production workflow; Clear Communication captures fit between the message and the reader's task.

contextual-language-coach.reason: The effective protocol rehearses language for a concrete low-risk interaction, includes repair phrases and updates the phrase set from actual difficulty. Language Learning is primary; Skill Learning captures rehearsal, feedback and adjustment.

control-to-action-compass.reason: The effective protocol separates a concern into directly controllable actions, external dependencies and observable outcomes before choosing a next action. Decision Making captures that allocation choice without routing the protocol into general work-system or planning queries.

ready-to-resume-plan.reason: The protocol concerns interruption recovery and preserving a concrete restart point for unfinished work.

visible-progress-monitoring.reason: The protocol is a self-regulation feedback loop linking observable goal progress to the next action.

if-then-rules-productivity.reason: Implementation intentions are a cue-response self-regulation method used to support goal follow-through and task initiation.

stop-caffeine-after-lunch.reason: The effective protocol is about adjusting caffeine dose and timing to protect subsequent sleep. Sleep & Circadian Rhythm is the primary Topic and Everyday Health Basics preserves the general-health context.

grayscale-phone-friction.reason: The protocol changes a device default to reduce visual salience and habitual engagement, making Digital Attention and Environment Design the direct Topics.

batch-non-urgent-notifications.reason: The intervention restructures digital interruptions to protect attention without removing access, mapping directly to Digital Attention and Attention & Focus.

deliberate-email-checking-windows.reason: The protocol changes the timing of inbox access as both a digital-attention intervention and a work-system design choice.

savor-positive-moment.reason: The bounded nonclinical practice concerns attention to positive experience and observation of one's response, fitting Mood & Wellbeing and Self-Awareness.

post-meal-walk.reason: The public action is a general movement substitution after meals with explicit health boundaries, not a treatment protocol.

genuine-micro-conversation.reason: The protocol concerns small context-sensitive social interactions and low-pressure initiation rather than conflict repair or formal communication training.

consider-the-opposite.reason: The action is a structured debiasing check used while evaluating evidence and judgments, directly connecting decision-making, cognitive-bias awareness and critical thinking.

temptation-bundling.reason: The method adds an immediate reward to a delayed-benefit action. Field evidence is strongest for exercise, while the reusable mechanism concerns starting and repeating beneficial behavior.

build-your-support-network.reason: The effective protocol maps a concrete need to an appropriate person or resource, makes a bounded request, and preserves consent and relationship boundaries. Relationships is the primary Topic; Clear Communication covers the explicit request and correction step.

break-down-big-problems-triz.reason: The effective protocol frames a hard problem as a contradiction, generates separation or redesign options, and checks a reversible change. Problem Solving and Creative Problem Solving describe the task; TRIZ is the explicit Method.

attention-to-detail-trainer.reason: The effective protocol converts known failure modes into a repeatable artifact-verification loop and updates the checklist from real misses. Error Prevention is primary; Work Systems captures the recurring review process.

break-big-goals-into-steps.reason: The effective protocol defines a finish condition, exposes dependencies, decomposes work into observable deliverables, and chooses the next useful step. Goals and Planning & Prioritization are the concrete Topics.

phase-transition-ritual-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol is an operational handoff between activities: preserve unfinished state, make one visible closing move, and name the first action in the next mode. Work Systems captures the handoff; Attention & Focus captures the context-switching boundary without implying a therapeutic mechanism.

process-of-elimination-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol narrows a choice by applying defensible constraints, separating unknowns from failures, and comparing only viable survivors. Decision Making is primary; Problem Solving covers the structured elimination and information-gaining step.

qa-clear-feedback-templates.reason: The reviewed protocol turns an observed defect into an actionable QA handoff with reproduction context, redacted evidence, explicit hypotheses, expected behavior, and an acceptance check. Error Prevention covers verification; Clear Communication covers the handoff structure.

ai-professional-writing-draft.reason: A writing-and-revision workflow; Using AI is the navigation collection, while Writing and Revision & Feedback are the concrete capabilities.

ai-idea-divergence-pass.reason: The protocol expands creative options before selection.

ai-task-frontier-test.reason: The user evaluates where AI belongs inside a workflow and routes work by observed task fit and risk.

ai-customer-reply-coach.reason: The practical surface is clearer customer communication under human control.

ai-code-scaffold-test-loop.reason: AI-assisted implementation is embedded in an explicit testing and review loop.

ai-learning-attempt-feedback-retest.reason: The protocol preserves learner attempts, feedback and unaided retesting.

ai-source-summary-verification.reason: The workflow compresses information while preserving traceability and source checks.

ai-meeting-notes-to-actions.reason: The protocol converts meeting records into checked decisions and action handoffs.

ai-test-case-generator.reason: The core task is failure-mode discovery followed by executable checks.

ai-decision-alternatives.reason: The protocol broadens options and challenges premature closure while keeping decision authority human.

ai-rubric-critique.reason: The model provides criterion-bound feedback on a user-owned draft.

ai-conversation-rehearsal.reason: The user rehearses wording and response flexibility for an ordinary difficult conversation.

ai-structured-extraction-check.reason: The workflow turns unstructured text into traceable structured information and verifies errors before downstream use.

ai-sop-from-examples.reason: The protocol captures recurring work as a validated operating procedure.
